_note: Named viewpoints for folly_view, offered as buttons on its Parameters page in this order. Target is where the camera looks, in the cathedral's metres: x is depth (the playa-facing front is negative, about -12; the back is about +14), y is height above the ground (spires top out near 18.5), z runs left to right (about -9 to +8). Distance is metres from the target; Angle turns round it (0 stands in front on the playa side, 90 on the cathedral's right); Elevation tips the camera above level (negative looks up from below); Fov is the horizontal field of view in degrees. With Eyelock the camera stands at folly_view's Eye Height, like a person, and Elevation is ignored. Names must be lowercase letters and digits: each becomes a button, and the buttons are part of the library's API, so adding a view needs a new minor version of folly_view and renaming or removing one a new major version.
